## Services
- AI automation: ERP/CRM sync into a Postgres warehouse, scheduled reports (cash flow, debtors, sales), alerts to Telegram.
- AI agents: natural-language assistants over live company data, tool use with approval gates, deployed on the client's server, local models where they fit.
- AI chatbots: sales and support inside Telegram; storefront, cart, orders as a Mini App with plain-button fallback; admin panel; Uzbek and Russian.
- Websites: Next.js, statically generated, bilingual, structured data, forms delivered by email.

## Experience
- Digital Systems Engineer, Supply Group LLC (four-division retail group), Jul 2026 – present: three production Telegram bots, PostgreSQL warehouse with Smartup ERP ETL, Power BI dashboards, automated cash-flow reporting, Dockerized Linux server with 17 services, LLM financial assistant.
- BSc Mechanical Engineering, New Uzbekistan University, 2025 – 2029.
